writing.explanation: An annotation does not change how long anything lives. It tells the compiler how input and output borrows are connected, so it can prove a returned reference never outlives the data behind it. Most of the time inference handles this and you write nothing at all.
writing.feedback: With one input reference it is inferred; with two the relationship must be stated.
